name: Fleetwood Mac

whyMatters.en: British-American band whose 1975–77 Buckingham–Nicks lineup turned soft-rock harmony and studio polish into Rumours-scale pop-rock dominance.
whyMatters.zh: 英美乐队：1975–77 Buckingham–Nicks 阵容把软摇滚和声与录音室抛光做成 Rumours 级流行摇滚统治。

note.en: Rumours opener energy; fingerstyle + stacked choruses.
note.zh: Rumours 开场能量；指弹 + 叠副歌。

note.en: Nicks vocal over sparse groove; US No.1.
note.zh: Nicks 人声盖稀疏律动；美国冠军。

note.en: Peter Green blues-rock era before pop polish.
note.zh: 流行抛光前的 Peter Green 蓝调摇滚期。

interviewQuotes.text: We made Rumours while breaking up with each other.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Lindsey Buckingham

lyricQuotes: If I could / Baby I'd give you my world
Thunder only happens when it's raining

shortBio.en: Buckingham–Nicks Rumours peak; Green-era blues origin; Go Your Own Way is the hit.
shortBio.zh: Buckingham–Nicks 的 Rumours 峰值；Green 时期蓝调起源；Go Your Own Way 是热单。

body.en:
Formed 1967 as Peter Green blues band. 1975 Buckingham–Nicks join; Fleetwood Mac (1975) and Rumours (1977) define California soft-rock harmony with UK rhythm section.

Lineup versions matter: blues Mac vs Rumours Mac. Peak flag on Buckingham–Nicks five.
body.zh:
1967 作为 Peter Green 蓝调乐队组建。1975 Buckingham–Nicks 加入；同名专（1975）与 Rumours（1977）用英国节奏组定义加州软摇滚和声。

阵容版本重要：蓝调 Mac vs Rumours Mac。巅峰旗在 Buckingham–Nicks 五人。

title.zh: 录音室和声当流行摇滚机器

body.en:
Rumours sells stacked vocals, Buckingham fingerstyle attack, and radio-length songs. Drama is biographical; sound is meticulous multi-track craft.

Soft-rock that still hits like hard arrangement.
body.zh:
Rumours 卖叠人声、Buckingham 指弹攻击与电台长度歌。戏剧是传记性的；声音是精密多轨工艺。

仍像硬编曲那样打人的软摇滚。

title.zh: Green 蓝调 vs Buckingham–Nicks 巅峰

body.en:
1967–70: Green / McVie / Fleetwood blues-rock. 1975–87: Buckingham / Nicks / Christine / John / Mick is the commercial silhouette.

Peak flag: Rumours five. Blues chapter is origin, not the mass logo.
body.zh:
1967–70：Green / McVie / Fleetwood 蓝调摇滚。1975–87：Buckingham / Nicks / Christine / John / Mick 是商业剪影。

巅峰旗：Rumours 五人。蓝调章节是起源，不是大众 logo。

title.zh: 三主唱、指弹、锁死节奏组

body.en:
Nicks/Christine/Buckingham share leads. Buckingham produces and fingerpicks. John/Mick hold blues pocket under pop sheen.

Chemistry is romantic math and mic placement.
body.zh:
Nicks/Christine/Buckingham 分主唱。Buckingham 制作并指弹。John/Mick 在流行光泽下守蓝调律动。

化学反应是情感算术与话筒位置。

title.en: Go Your Own Way: Rumours attack
title.zh: Go Your Own Way：Rumours 攻击

body.en:
Acoustic-electric drive, Nicks harmony answers, Fleetwood tom hits. Breakup lyric as radio fuel.

Buckingham–Nicks era face single.
body.zh:
木电驱动、Nicks 和声应答、Fleetwood 通通鼓。分手歌词当电台燃料。

Buckingham–Nicks 时期门面单曲。

body.en:
Minimal groove, Nicks lead, Christine keys pad. Proves Rumours range beyond rockers.

US chart peak of the lineup.
body.zh:
极简律动、Nicks 主唱、Christine 键盘垫。证明 Rumours 不止摇滚曲。

该阵容的美国榜峰值。

title.zh: 跨年代引用的和声流行

body.en:
Adult-contemporary and indie revival both pull Rumours stacking. Green-era tracks stay blues-club citations.

Two bands under one name—chronicle keeps both, peaks the five.
body.zh:
成人当代与 indie 复兴都抽 Rumours 叠声。Green 时期曲目留在蓝调俱乐部引用。

一名两队——编年史两边都留，巅峰钉在五人。

note.en: Rumours single that fixed Buckingham–Nicks radio ID.
note.zh: 固定 Buckingham–Nicks 电台 ID 的 Rumours 单曲。

note.en: Blues origin to Rumours harmony machine under one logo.
note.zh: 同一 logo 下：蓝调起源到 Rumours 和声机器。
